references.text: Joshua rose early in the morning, as was his custom during the siege of Jericho
The priests carried the Lord's ark of the covenant, just as they did during the crossing of the Jordan
The ark of the covenant was carried by the priests, in accordance with God's command on how the ark should be transported
The priests bore the ark of the testimony, which was their holy duty
The Lord's ark of the covenant went before the people, just as it did around Jericho
Abraham rose early in the morning to obey the Lord's command, a pattern that Joshua followed
Moses rose early in the morning to serve the Lord, just as Joshua also did
